claim:
    ? forall S finite_set,f fn(x S) R:
        forall x S:
            0 <= f(x)
        =>:
            0 <= finite_set_sum(S,f)
    finite_set_sum(S,fn(x S) R {0}) = 0
    release thm finite_set_sum_le_from_pointwise(finite_set_sum(S,fn(x S) R {0}),finite_set_sum(S,f))

forall S finite_set,f fn(x S) R,M R:
    forall x S:
        f(x) <= M
    =>:
        finite_set_sum(S,f) <= finite_set_size(S)*M

claim:
    ? forall S finite_set,f fn(x S) R,M R:
        forall x S:
            f(x) <= M
        =>:
            finite_set_sum(S,f) <= finite_set_size(S)*M
    finite_set_sum(S,fn(x S) R {M}) = M*finite_set_size(S) = finite_set_size(S)*M
    release thm finite_set_sum_le_from_pointwise(finite_set_sum(S,f),finite_set_sum(S,fn(x S) R {M}))

forall f,g fn(x Z) R,m,n Z:

        m <= x <= n
        =>:
            f(x) <= g(x)
    =>:
        sum(m,n,f) <= sum(m,n,g)

claim:
    ? forall f,g fn(x Z) R,m,n Z:
        m <= n
        forall x Z:
            m <= x <= n
            =>:
                f(x) <= g(x)
        =>:
            sum(m,n,f) <= sum(m,n,g)
    release thm sum_le_sum_from_pointwise(sum(m,n,f),sum(m,n,g))

    ? forall f fn(x Z) R,m,n Z:

    sum(m,n,fn(x Z) R {f(x)}) = finite_set_sum(m...n,fn(x Z) R {f(x)})
    sum(m,n,fn(x Z) R {abs(f(x))}) = finite_set_sum(m...n,fn(x Z) R {abs(f(x))})
    finite_set_sum(m...n,fn(x Z) R {abs(f(x))}) = finite_set_sum(m...n,fn(x m...n) R {abs(f(x))})
    abs(sum(m,n,fn(x Z) R {f(x)})) = abs(finite_set_sum(m...n,fn(x Z) R {f(x)})) <= finite_set_sum(m...n,fn(x m...n) R {abs(f(x))}) = finite_set_sum(m...n,fn(x Z) R {abs(f(x))}) = sum(m,n,fn(x Z) R {abs(f(x))})

    sum(m,n,fn(x N+) R {c*f(x)}) = sum(m,n,fn(x m...n) R {c*f(x)})
    sum(m,n,fn(x N+) R {f(x)}) = sum(m,n,fn(x m...n) R {f(x)})
    sum(m,n,fn(x m...n) R {c*f(x)}) = c*sum(m,n,fn(x m...n) R {f(x)})

    abs(sum(m,n,f)) = abs(finite_set_sum(m...n,f)) <= finite_set_sum(m...n,fn(x m...n) R {abs(f(x))}) = sum(m,n,fn(x Z) R {abs(f(x))})
